errors.cli_missing: wgsplit not found at {path}. Run the dotfiles install.sh.
errors.tunnel_down: The tunnel is off, so {command} would use the normal connection. Turn it on first.

launcher.custom: Run this command through the tunnel

notifications.attached: Moved {target} into the tunnel. Only new connections use it.
notifications.down: Tunnel off. Apps use the normal connection.
notifications.down_killswitch: Tunnel off. Kill switch is blocking tunneled apps.
notifications.released: Kill switch off. Tunneled apps use the normal connection.

panel.apps_empty: No apps configured. Add commands in the plugin settings.
panel.attach_hint: Process name or PID. Connections it already has stay where they are; reconnecting moves them.
panel.dns_down: forwarder stopped (no DNS in the tunnel)
panel.killswitch_hint: Apps started through the tunnel are offline until you turn it back on or release them.
panel.run_placeholder: Command to run through the tunnel
panel.unavailable_hint: Install wgsplit with the dotfiles install.sh and put your WireGuard config in /etc/wireguard/wgsplit.conf.

apps.description: Commands listed in the panel and launcher. A command whose app is already running opens a window in that process, which is not tunneled: use separate instances (for example firefox --new-instance -P vpn).
apps.label: Apps

auto_up.description: Turn the tunnel on when Noctalia starts.
auto_up.label: Connect on startup

kill_switch.description: When the tunnel is turned off, keep tunneled apps offline instead of falling back to the normal connection.
kill_switch.label: Kill switch

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often the tunnel state is read.
poll_interval_seconds.label: Refresh interval (s)
